IA NO: 1 OF 2020 Petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C and 528 of BNSS praying that in the circumstances stated in the Memorandum of Grounds of Criminal Petition,the High Court may be pleased pleased to grant stay of all further proceedings including appearance of the petitioners in C.C.No.73 of 2018 on the file of the court of Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Parchur, pending disposal of the main Criminal petition IA NO: 1 OF 2021 Petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C and 528 of BNSS praying that in the circumstances stated in the Memorandum of Grounds of Criminal Petition,the High Court may be pleased Pleased to extend the interim order passed in Crl.P.
824/2020 until further orders

Counsel for the Petitioner/accused:
1. MARRI VENKATA RAMANA Counsel for the Respondent/complainant(S):
1. PUBLIC PROSECUTOR (AP) The Court Made the Following Order:

The instant petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C., has been filed by the petitioner herein, seeking quashment of proceedings against him in C.C. No.73 of 2018 on the file of the learned Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Parchur, for the offences under Chouta Alias Chavata Mohana Rao, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 17 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/93487582/
1 Sections 273 and 188 IPC and Section 58 of the Food Safety Standards Act, 2006.
